name: Wire firestarter
description: Two steel leads taped to a stick, ending in a small wire coil. Touched to a battery, the coil heats enough to light tinder.
notes: Home-made, so mostly found where survivors have been. The model is 14 cm long.

name: Arc lighter
description: A rechargeable lighter that strikes an electric arc between two points under a flip lid. Needs no fuel, only a charge.
notes: Modelled with the lid tipped back, so its length reads as the body plus the open lid.

name: Bow drill
description: A notched hearth board, a spindle, a palm block and a corded bow. Sawing the bow spins the spindle until the dust in the notch smoulders.
notes: Modelled set up for use, spindle standing in the hearth with the bow across it, so the box is mostly air; packed flat the parts take far less room. No rock-drilling quality: a fire drill bores no stone.

name: Pump drill
description: A tall shaft weighted with a stone flywheel, spun by pumping a crossbar up and down on its cords. Faster at raising an ember than a bow drill.
notes: Modelled standing on its hearth board with the crossbar raised, with a working 50 cm shaft and 14 cm flywheel, so the shape follows the real tool. No rock-drilling quality.

name: Fire piston
description: A sealed wooden cylinder and a tight-fitting piston. Driving the piston home heats the trapped air enough to light a scrap of tinder on its tip. A small pot keeps tinder dry.
notes: The cylinder seal is drawn as a band of cord; the tinder pot uses the bone finish for horn.

name: Flint and steel
description: A C-shaped hardened steel striker and a lump of flint. Struck together, they throw sparks onto char cloth or dry tinder.
notes: The whole kit is a real striker and flint, and the item has no stack. Flint uses the obsidian finish, with a chalk-white patch for its rind; a matte grey-brown flint finish would read better.

name: Rough glass lens
description: A thick lens ground from ordinary glass. Too poor for optics, but it focuses sunlight sharply enough to light tinder.
notes: A crafted part; the box is large because a lens is thin at its rim. Fire starting needs direct sun.

name: Magnifying glass
description: A large glass lens in a rimmed frame on a wooden handle. Enlarges fine print and small parts, and lights tinder in direct sun.
notes: Lies flat; glass draws opaque in the tiles but is see-through in the game. The box is large because of the open handle.

name: Flip-top lighter
description: A metal lighter with a hinged lid over a windproof chimney. Burns lighter fluid and can be refilled.
notes: Modelled with the lid swung open. Deadvox's existing lighter has an igniter block and a fuel fill port; this one should take the same once fuel items for it exist.

name: Butane torch lighter
description: A large lighter with a trigger, a safety slide and a forward nozzle. A can of butane fits up into its base.
notes: The can's red base shows under the grip. The box is large because the nozzle and trigger stand out from the grip.

name: Mini lighter
description: A small disposable plastic lighter. It cannot be refilled.
notes: Built on the existing lighter family at a smaller size, with a pink body to tell it from the full-size lighter.

name: Storm match
description: A single match with a long, thick head that strikes on any rough surface and keeps burning in wind and rain. Good for one fire.
notes: One match is one item. The head is modelled thicker than a 2 mm voxel would otherwise show.

name: Ember carrier
description: A lidded tin punched with air holes and hung from a wire bail. Packed with tinder, it keeps an ember alive for hours.
notes: Cold state; lighting it swaps to `smouldering_ember_carrier`. The box is large because of the bail. The air holes are painted flush, since compound pieces cannot cut.

name: Ember carrier (smouldering)
description: A punched tin with an ember glowing through its air holes. It can light a campfire.
notes: A distinct state, so it has its own model: the cold carrier with its holes glowing. Not loot: it only exists once a player lights the cold one, so it is notLoot with an empty economy.
